note: ORIGINAL quatrains only. Never X posts, quote-posts or reposts. Add only after Chris approves. Schema in docs/PROPHECY-STYLE.md.

prophecies.title: The Yield Ascends
lines: The ten-year scroll shall climb to heights unseen
Since two thousand two, when flip phones still were keen.
The wise shall flee to bonds, the bold to stocks.
And I shall hide my coins inside my socks.
prophecies.about: The 10-year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2002 (5.25% on 9/29)

prophecies.title: Few Shall Be Hired
lines: In autumn's month, few toilers shall be hired,
Yet merchants cheer as if their luck conspired.
Bad tidings make the market dance with glee.
I read the omens. None were meant for me.
prophecies.about: Only 29,000 jobs were added in September and stocks rose anyway

prophecies.title: The Black Blood
lines: The black blood of the earth shall cross one hundred,
And every chariot's purse shall be well plundered.
I sold my horse to buy a modern car.
I should have kept the horse. It went as far.
prophecies.about: Oil briefly topped $100 a barrel this week

prophecies.title: The Forge That Eats Itself
lines: The green forge that makes the thinking stones
Shall spend its gold to buy its very bones.
A snake that feeds upon its tail grows fat.
I tried this with my lunch. I do not recommend that.
prophecies.about: A chipmaker announced a $150 billion buyback of its own stock

prophecies.title: The Eagle's Scribes
lines: On Wednesday next the Eagle's scribes shall speak,
And traders hang on every word they leak.
The market shall go up, then down, then wander.
This prophecy is final. I will ponder.
prophecies.about: The Fed releases its meeting minutes on Wednesday 10/7

prophecies.title: The Coin of Air
lines: The coin of air shall rise with the harvest moon,
And men shall sing its praises far too soon.
I bought one sliver at the very peak.
It was a Tuesday. It has been a week.

prophecies.title: The People's Gloom
lines: The people's cheer shall sink to twelve-year lows,
And gloom shall follow everywhere coin goes.
Yet still they'll pay five coins for frothy bean.
I saw all this. I also bought a latte. Twice.
prophecies.about: Consumer confidence fell to its lowest level since 2014
